set.body: Move beyond purely in-memory fixtures while keeping the core boundary clean. Deliverables: a backend bridge for a concrete fMRI data source, starting with JVM NIfTI or matrix-backed file data as appropriate; shared DatasetBackend contracts remain cross-compilable; platform-specific IO stays under jvm/. Acceptance: backend contract tests pass, a small fixture can be read into FmriSeries, and the resulting dataset can run through the OLS FitPlanExecutor path.
set.title: Slice 6: real dataset/backend bridge
